issue.title: fix(app): show actionable error when API URL is unset or unreachable
issue.body:
## Summary

Harden the app shell (`App.tsx`) so developers see a clear, actionable message when `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL` is missing or the API health check fails — without mock data or auth bypass (reduced scope from descoped #107).

## Context

Refs #119

Original #107 (offline auto-auth bypass) was descoped. This ticket covers only startup UX when configuration or connectivity blocks sign-in/sync.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Missing `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL` shows an error pointing to `.env.example` / local development workflow docs
- [ ] Unauthenticated startup with URL set but API unreachable shows an error with retry (no infinite spinner)
- [ ] Returning users with a stored session token still enter the app offline (no regression)
- [ ] No mock seed, no `EXPO_PUBLIC_OFFLINE_MODE`, no auth bypass

## Verification

1. Unset env var → rebuild → actionable config error on launch
2. Point URL at dead host → unauthenticated launch shows unreachable error + retry works when API comes up
3. Sign in, kill API, relaunch → app opens with cached SQLite data
4. `npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test -- --ci`

comments.body: Closing as not planned for epic #119. The local development workflow is now docs-only in PR #136; no app-shell hardening or seed-related mobile work is needed for this scope.
